text.text_excerpt: Before leaving for my yearly New Orleans trip, my parents recommended this place for happy hour. And my parents know a good happy hour when they find one. I enjoyed it so much that I went two out of my three nights in town. While the happy hour specials are incredible ($2 select drink specials, $2 select apps), this place also knows their cocktails. I started with a sazerac, and it was one of the better renditions of the beverage that I've had. I then moved on to one of the martinis on special - pomegranite. Very tasty, I think I actually had two. I really hit paydirt with the appetizer special though - lobster beignets. Holy smokes, were these delicious! The second night my drink order w...

Food here is delicious!! Drinks are superb! Atmosphere is amazing! I'm just looking for another reason to visit. This review is long over due as I visited quite a few months back. I surprised my husband with dinner in a booth post a spa day for our anniversary. The wait staff were very friendly from the time we arrived, to the time we left. Great New Orleans vibes, while keeping true to the fancy British pub atmosphere. If you can reserve a booth, I would, just for the experience. There was live music, and the band (though I couldn't see them through the closed curtain), was such a great added bonus to the night. This is not The Bombay Club I remember when I came here for college. This place has had a huge makeover and looks better than ever. First off, this place has live music everyday, a great bar area and a super cute patio. Great place to come with friends or to get away for the bourbon craziness to catch your breath. The drinks here are fairly priced and most importantly STRONG & TASTY! They don't mess around with their drinks here. They also have a great happy hour! Definitely check it out. As for the food it's much much much better than I ever remembered. I had some bites off the happy hour menu. Started off with the pretzel... so warm and you can tell it was freshly made.
